planets.name: GJ 806 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of GJ 806 with a 0.926-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: GJ 806 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around GJ 806. Its orbit and size follow Palle et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
